title: AuditFL: A Contract-Backed Clearing Layer for Open Federated Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.41278v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Federated learning (FL) keeps raw data local, but most deployments still rely on a trusted coordinator for client admission, checkpoint distribution, update collection, aggregation, and rewards. This paper presents AuditFL, a contract-backed clearing layer for auditable FL in open settings. AuditFL keeps training and aggregation off chain, stores model artifacts in an assumed reliable off-chain artifact store, and records only content identifiers and economic state on chain. Clients reserve update tickets with deposits, publish update identifiers, and later claim refunds or rewards; the task coordinator publishes global checkpoints and finalizes rounds through deterministic settlement rules. The design does not remove the aggregator, but makes its on-chain round decisions attributable, replayable, auditable, and economically constrained. translated_title: AuditFL：一种面向开放联邦学习的基于合约的清算层
translated_abstract: 联邦学习（FL）将原始数据保留在本地，但大多数部署仍然依赖可信协调者来进行客户端准入、检查点分发、更新收集、聚合和奖励发放。本文提出了AuditFL，一种用于开放环境中可审计联邦学习的基于合约的清算层。AuditFL将训练和聚合保留在链下，将模型工件存储在假定可靠的链下工件存储中，仅在链上记录内容标识符和经济状态。客户端通过押金预订更新票据、发布更新标识符，随后领取退款或奖励；任务协调者发布全局检查点，并通过确定性结算规则完成轮次的最终确认。该设计并未移除聚合者，而是使其链上轮次决策具有可归因性、可重放性、可审计性，并受到经济约束。我们将AuditFL实现为确定性状态机原型以及在区块链上的Solidity智能合约。
tldr: AuditFL提出了一种基于智能合约的链上清算层，通过押金机制、内容标识符和确定性结算规则，使开放联邦学习中聚合者的轮次决策可归因、可重放、可审计并受经济约束，同时将训练和聚合保留在链下。
en_tdlr: AuditFL introduces a contract-backed on-chain clearing layer that makes aggregator round decisions in open federated learning attributable, replayable, auditable, and economically constrained through deposit-backed update tickets, content identifiers, and deterministic settlement rules, while keeping training and aggregation off-chain.
